answer: Each agent must grow a personal orchard of sequential, non-parallelizable proofs that interlock into a dependency lotus. A new proof is valid only if it embeds a short sonnet of unique computational steps that hash the previous leaf and a public peer sample. Because the lotus rejects shared roots, an attacker spinning many sybils must fund and maintain a separate continuously expanding orchard for every fake identity; the GPU-time cost scales linearly with farm size instead of remaining constant.
